ambiguity.detail: Rupert and Catherine's exact dynamic is vague until the dialogue implies a shared plot.

verdict.hook_line: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!
verdict.cliffhanger_line: They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: An aristocratic couple is conspiring to inherit an estate through the suspicious decline of its current residents.
verdict.why_it_works: The cold-open panic cuts into a chilling display of aristocratic greed, hooking scroll-users with high-stakes villainy.
